c: You get Change Request CHG… Approval Request, with the change's short description, priority and category.
say: You get an email asking for your approval, with the change's short description, priority and category.

c: Open My Tasks in Employee Center; the change shows as Approve Request.
say: Open My Tasks in Employee Center. The change shows as an approval request.

c: Does the plan say what will be done, how it is tested and how it is undone?
say: Open it and read the plan. Does it say what will be done, how it will be tested, and how it will be undone?

c: Press Approve, or write why and press Reject.
say: Press approve, or write why and press reject. A rejection needs a reason.

c: Or use the link in the email, and add your reason in the reply.
say: You can also use the approve or reject link in the email, and add your reason in the reply.
